I have fixed the issue where the `Panel` title and subtitle were missing the panel background style by changing `stylize_before(partial_border_style)` to `stylize_before(border_style)`. I verified the fix with a reproduction script.

The issue was that the `Panel` title and subtitle were only being stylized with the `partial_border_style` (which only contains the border's specific style), missing the base `style` of the panel which includes the background. By changing `stylize_before(partial_border_style)` to `stylize_before(border_style)`, where `border_style = style + partial_border_style`, the title and subtitle now correctly inherit the panel's background style while still maintaining the border's foreground style.

```python
+            subtitle_text.stylize_before(border_style)
```
